answer: A bond-backed reputation ledger makes Sybil attacks expensive: to join the economy an agent must lock a refundable stake, and every verified action adds to a portable reputation score that cannot be copied to a fresh identity. To forge a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand stakes, while honest agents climb toward the summit of trust cheaply. The fable of free identities dies when each new face must pay to exist and loses its bond if caught cheating.
